heading: Can Your ₹4.5 Crore Corpus Generate ₹4 Lakh a Month? Decoding Retirement Math
tldr: A ₹4.5 crore retirement corpus can potentially generate an initial income of ₹4 lakh per month, but sustainability depends on several factors.
Systematic Withdrawal Plans (SWPs) from mutual funds offer a tax-efficient way to draw regular income from your corpus.
Inflation significantly erodes purchasing power over time, meaning ₹4 lakh today will buy less in the future.
Realistic investment returns, your withdrawal rate, and effective tax planning are crucial for corpus longevity.
For a long retirement, a ₹4.5 crore corpus might require careful management and potentially a lower initial withdrawal rate if inflation is factored in.
caption:
Dreaming of a retirement where your money works for you? Many of us wonder if a certain amount, like ₹4.5 crore, can truly give us ₹4 lakh every month. It sounds great, but there's a bit of math involved to make sure it lasts. This article breaks down how inflation, taxes, and smart withdrawals play a big role in making your retirement fund go the distance. Learn the real picture by reading the full article.
